variants.headline: Assembly votes the government out
variants.body: The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Confidence withdrawn
variants.body: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Office meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
